source: Kinds of income common in kink, sex work and domme practice, with a common platform cut as a starting point. Cuts are the rough middle of what performers report publicly; every site sets its own and changes it.
confidenceNote: The fee starting points are suggestions a person taps, never written on their own. Your platform's own statement is the number to use.
note: w2 is true for pay that arrives with tax withheld (a vanilla job). Everything else is self-employment income for the tax page. platformRisk says how fast the stream can vanish through no fault of yours: high means a policy change or a ban can end it overnight.

kinds.label: Subscriptions
kinds.hint: A monthly fan or subscriber site: subs, tips and paid messages.

kinds.label: Clips and content sales
kinds.hint: Clip stores, custom videos, photo sets.

kinds.label: Cam and live shows
kinds.hint: Live streaming, token and private shows.

kinds.label: Tributes and financial domination
kinds.hint: Tributes, gifts, drains, wishlist and cash gifts. Fees are the payment rail's, not a platform's.

kinds.label: Phone, text and voice
kinds.hint: Phone lines, texting and audio, paid by the minute or the month.

kinds.label: Teaching, events and workshops
kinds.hint: Classes, demos, con appearances, coaching, rope or impact intensives.

kinds.label: Goods and merch
kinds.hint: Worn items, gear you make, prints, merch.

kinds.label: Vanilla job (tax withheld)
kinds.hint: A job that pays with tax already taken out. Counted as wages, not self-employment.

kinds.label: Something else
kinds.hint: Anything the list does not name.

concentration.oneStreamNote: When one stream brings half or more of what you keep, its platform holds your rent. The fund page adds a buffer for it.
